title.en: TOWN AND COUNTRY PLANNING REPEAL NOTIFICATION 2021

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-47-2021-TOWN-AND-COUNTRY-PLANNING-REPEAL-NOTIFICATION-2021.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 6 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en:
This Notification may be cited as the Town and Country Planning (Repeal) Notification, 2021 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 1st January 2017. Repeal of Notifications 2 . The Notifications set out in the Schedule are hereby repealed.

SCHEDULE (paragraph 2)

REPEALED NOTIFICATIONS
Declaration under section 3 (Development Control Area): Muara Development Control Area (S 4911975).
Notice following the declaration of the Main Road Development Control Areas (S 15611974).

Notice following the declaration of the whole of the State of Brunei as a Subdivision Development Control Area (S 15711 974). Authority (Main Roads) in respect of the "Main Road Development Control Areas" (S 15511974). 16th. NOVEMBER. 2021 Authority (Main Roads) responsible for the Main Road Development Control Areas (S 2011975).
Notification of appointment of Competent Authority: Muara Development Control Competent Authority (S 5011975).

Notification of appointment of Competent Authority: ~ u b o k Development Control Competent Authority (S 7011975). Made this 5th. day of Zulkaedah, 1442 Hijriah corresponding to the 16th. day of June, 2021. DATO SERI SETIA Ir. AWANG HAJI SUHAIMI BIN HAJI GAFAR Minister of Development.
